description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating high-bandwidth network detection and management, with UI handling for network requests, connections, and user prompts.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity managing network connectivity detection and UI states for high-bandwidth network requirements.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, system services, and handler; sets up network callback logic.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases high-bandwidth network resources when activity stops.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks network status and updates UI upon resuming activity.

methods.name: isNetworkHighBandwidth
methods.description: Returns true if current network meets minimum bandwidth requirement.

methods.name: requestHighBandwidthNetwork
methods.description: Requests a high-bandwidth network and handles callback events.

methods.name: addWifiNetwork
methods.description: Starts activity to add Wi-Fi network for high-bandwidth use.

methods.name: onButtonClick
methods.description: Handles UI button clicks, triggering network requests or other actions.

methods.name: setUiState
methods.description: Updates the UI components based on current network and app state.
